capture.start: After successful real ADC start transaction and final clock_ok; not physical CEN timestamp
capture.main_freeze: First queue push FULL before terminate/raw_barrier/quiesce
capture.limit_effect: Target foreground checkpoint only; actual elapsed and overshoot from recorded end; freeze observation only, no source Stop

memory.proof_required: Exact new ELF/map/static; no new stack snapshot; all added globals included
memory.exact_abi: firmware/v2-stream/profile/mt_stream_profile.h and profile/ABI.md;512 bytes incl separate FG/ISR flags and every private field

concurrency.IRQ_priority_assumption: Existing USB19/20 same priority0, no nesting between them
concurrency.raw_reader: One direct aligned volatile CYCCNT read; no TIME/clock validation or legacy mt_stream_diag_cycle call
concurrency.guard_outcome: Record first actually evaluated false short-circuit term without a repeated MMIO read
concurrency.freeze_protocol: end_before raw read; ACTIVE->CLOSING aligned volatile32 store; end_after raw read; one RAM-only snapshot/partial intervals; compiler memory barrier+DMB; FROZEN; no late writer may change even private open flags
concurrency.boundary_uncertainty: Start/end marker brackets explicitly bound attribution ambiguity; no pretend atomic CPU boundary
concurrency.publication_vs_completion: Different instants and owners; boundary transfers prevent treating these counters as a conservation invariant

validity.cycle_arithmetic: uint32 modulo; each interval <2^32; single zero crossing allowed
validity.overlap: TIME/STEP/USB ISR/GRANT_INTERVAL overlap other wall intervals; never sum all as CPU percentages
validity.limits_are: Diagnostic-quality policy, not instrument acceptance or proof of an overhead upper bound
validity.observer_pair_indicator: min cycles per raw-read pair * raw-read-count / 2; heuristic for part of observer cost, not a proven lower/upper CPU bound; never subtracted

physical_plan_proposal.on_failure: Preserve evidence and restore S4 by verified procedure
